design.scope: A local, seeded search (the optimize tool) over the editable parameters, climbing one metric; every other criterion is re-checked on the result at every requested stage. Not a global optimum. Verdicts are only as good as the scenario models and the STATE inputs they rest on; each criterion row carries the weakest provenance kind behind it and the model's limiting factor. Lean verdicts are floating-point evaluations of the Lean-backed formulas, not kernel checks; by default only NEW binding violations (absent from the unedited parents) fail a design. A "no-model" criterion is not met. A designed parameter set is a shape, not a viable organism: MORPHOLOGICAL interpolation, not genetic hybridisation.

glide_run.scope: Still air over a flat surface; steady glide polar of stuffed flying fish in a wind tunnel; ranges are upper bounds (every metre at (L/D)max). Only glide_range_lean_bound_m is covered by the Lean theorem glide_range_le. Launch speed is the organism's own sourced leap/burst speed (or a labelled what-if). Takeoff (taxiing), control, stability, flapping and burst power are not modelled. survives = null (a glide attempt is not a lethal perturbation in this model); feasible = lift can carry the weight at the reachable launch speed (null if no sourced launch speed).

validity.notes: Mass 0.0006943 kg is outside 0.02-0.4 kg (polar specimens 0.04-0.06 kg; field fliers to ~0.4 kg): polar extrapolated. Mean-chord Reynolds number ~4.6e+3 is outside 5e3-1e5 around the polar's Re ~1e4 (Park & Choi: 'gliding flying fish (Re ~10^4)'; air kinematic viscosity 1.46e-5 m2/s). glide_range_total_m exceeds the Lean bound whenever the kinetic phase is non-zero; only glide_range_lean_bound_m is covered by glide_range_le. Fick bound: arterial PO2 taken equal to air PO2 and gills taken to work in air; gills do not ventilate in air (physiology chain), so for a gill-breather this is a generous upper bound. TFF: NOTES-FOR-HUB.md item 2 says only 29.5% of the flight muscle the simulator charges fits in the body. This module uses no muscle power (the Fick bound is the cap), so the issue does not enter here; any muscle-based claim for the TFF must take it into account.

glide.statement_en: If available mechanical power is spent on level flight, on raising the weight at vertical speed c, and on non-negative losses, then c ≤ (P_avail − P_req)/W. A steady glide with no thrust, lift equal to weight and L/D ≤ (L/D)max from height h covers at most h (L/D)max horizontally; with drag reduced by a fraction δ near the surface and lift unaffected, at most h (L/D)max/(1 − δ).

constraint_details.canEliminate: a claim that a single unpowered glide from height h covers more than the energy bound allows; taxiing thrust, repeated touch-and-go and wind are outside the model and must be committed separately
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C15, glide range.** A claimed steady unpowered glide of distance `x > h (L/D)_max / (1 - δ)` from
height `h` with drag reduced by a fraction `δ` near the surface (`δ = 0` away from it) is ruled out. -/
theorem glide_range_rules_out {W h D x LDmax loss Lift δ : ℝ} (hW : 0 < W) (hD : 0 < D) (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hlift : Lift = W) (hLD : Lift / D ≤ LDmax)
    (henergy : W * h = (1 - δ) * D * x + loss) (hloss : 0 ≤ loss) (hx : h * LDmax / (1 - δ) < x) : False := by
  have := glide_range_le_groundEffect hW hD hh hδ0 hδ1 hlift hLD henergy hloss
  linarith

constraint_details.canEliminate: a powered design claiming a climb rate its excess power cannot deliver
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C16, climb.** A claimed climb rate `c` above `(P_avail - P_req)/W` under the power balance is ruled out. -/
theorem climb_rules_out {W Pavail Preq c loss : ℝ} (hW : 0 < W) (hbal : Pavail = Preq + W * c + loss)
    (hloss : 0 ≤ loss) (h : climbRate W Pavail Preq < c) : False := by
  have := climbRate_le hW hbal hloss
  linarith

thermal.statement_en: Under the thermal-performance hypothesis (sustained power zero outside [CTmin, CTmax], and at most P_ref Q10^((T - T_ref)/10) inside), no positive sustained power is possible outside the thermal window, and sustained power never exceeds the Q10 bound.

constraint_details.canEliminate: a design that keeps swimming at a temperature outside its own thermal window
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- A design claiming positive sustained power outside its thermal window is ruled out. -/
theorem thermal_rules_out (H : ThermalPerformance) {T P : ℝ} (hout : T < H.ctMin ∨ H.ctMax < T)
    (hP : P ≤ H.sustained T) (hpos : 0 < P) : False := by
  have := no_sustained_power_outside H hout hP
  linarith

constraint_details.canEliminate: a design claiming at a cold temperature the power it has at a warm one
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- A design claiming more sustained power at `T` than the Q10 bound allows is ruled out. -/
theorem thermal_power_rules_out (H : ThermalPerformance) {T P : ℝ} (hP : P ≤ H.sustained T)
    (hbig : H.pRef * H.q10 ^ ((T - H.tRef) / 10) < P) : False := by
  have := sustained_power_le H hP
  linarith

lean_check.scope: NOT A KERNEL CHECK. The formulas the Lean constraints encode are evaluated in floating point. "holds" means the design satisfies the relation under its named hypotheses, never that the design is feasible; "violated" means the committed numbers break the relation under those hypotheses; "out-of-scope" means the law or the comparison is scoped (taxa, life stage, ranges) away from this design and says nothing either way (pass taxon to evaluate flying-fish-scoped rows). Laws listed in laws_without_browser_evaluation were not evaluated at all. Kernel certificates exist only for the recorded examples under lean/Delphi/Certificates/.
